final_wiki.answer-Q-6053-A59:
Q-6053: How many days from 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-12 (count end, not start)?

Answer: 364

Reasoning: 2021 is not a leap year, so 2021-12-12 is 365 days after 2020-12-12, which is 364 days after 2020-12-13 (since we don't count the start date, we count days from 12-14 through 12-12 of next year = 364 days). Equivalently: 2021-12-12 minus 2020-12-13 = 364 days.
